feedback.end: Words like “furthermore” link paragraphs by showing that the next paragraph is about the same topic, even if the specific content is different.

instruction.text: Read the text and select the word or phrase that links the second paragraph to the first.

atoms.b:
I was very late to work on Monday. My alarm did not sound, so I woke up one hour late. Then, I could not find my front door key.

((Furthermore,)) the train that I was on broke down and did not move for an hour and a half.

((Nevertheless)), he has signed up to play in a tennis tournament at the end of the year. He has already started to train for it.

atoms.b:
My sister is trying to open a bakery. There is lots to do. She needs to find a building and find a way to pay for it.

((In addition)), she will need to hire staff and make recipes for the bread and pastries.

trainers.instruction: Select the correct word or phrase to link the paragraphs.

atoms.b:
Lou enjoys arts and crafts. She spends most of her evenings painting or knitting. She is currently knitting a jumper for her niece.

((++On_the_other_hand In_addition)), Leila doesn’t enjoy arts and crafts. She much prefers to spend her evenings reading.

Devi has had a very stressful week. She has been studying for her upcoming exams every day, and she is finding it overwhelming.

((++Moreover However)), she worked both days over the weekend. She works in a café that is very close to her house. It was very busy on Saturday.

Daniel does not know how to ride a bike. He does not own a bike currently and, in fact, never has!

((++Nevertheless On_the_other_hand)), he has signed up to do a bike race next spring. He is nervous but also extremely excited.
